title: Agent-based model of migrating, signaling cells reproduces the observed head shapes

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Agent-based model of migrating, signaling cells reproduces the observed head shapes

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: In an agent-based model of planarian head regeneration in which static somatic cells emit a chemical signal and migratory cells (neoblasts or their progeny) are repelled by it, deactivating different subsets of signaling cells (representing octanol gap-junction blockade) reproduces the four observed head shapes, so a small set of gap-junction-regulated cell behaviors such as migration and cell-cell signaling can quantitatively explain the observed morphologies.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: Gap Junctional Blockade Stochastically Induces Different Species-Specific Head Anatomies in Genetically Wild-Type Girardia dorotocephala Flatworms

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Emmons-Bell M 2015, Gap Junctional Blockade Stochastically Induces Different Species-Specific Head Anatomies in Genetically Wild-Type Girardia dorotocephala Flatworms › 2. Results › 2.8. A Model of Planarian Head Shapes Arising from Cell Interactions

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: We conclude that a small set of cell-level behaviors, such as migration and cell-cell signaling that are known to be regulated by GJC and thus are perturbed by octanol exposure [35,39,49,98,101,102], can quantitatively explain the morphologies we observed in planaria.

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Emmons-Bell M, Durant F, Hammelman J, Bessonov N, Volpert V, Morokuma J, Pinet K, Adams DS, Pietak A, Lobo D, Levin M, “Gap Junctional Blockade Stochastically Induces Different Species-Specific Head Anatomies in Genetically Wild-Type Girardia dorotocephala Flatworms”, International journal of molecular sciences (2015), doi:10.3390/ijms161126065; section “2. Results › 2.8. A Model of Planarian Head Shapes Arising from Cell Interactions”. Scope: The authors' two-cell-type agent-based model of the planarian head with an elastic boundary

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2015-girardia-09: partially-resolvable, resolvability 0.66

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: The model is described sufficiently for a specialist reimplementation and its geometric outputs can be checked. Parameter selection and lack of out-of-sample validation mean reproduction resolves sufficiency, not the claim that these behaviors explain the biology.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Reimplement the two-cell-type agent model from the supplement and test whether prespecified deactivation patterns reproduce all four head-shape measurements out of sample. Compare its fit and complexity with alternative mechanical models.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Fit alone does not identify the biological mechanism.

Different deactivation patterns and boundary stiffness were selected for different target shapes.

The original C++ source is not identified as publicly deposited.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
discriminating power: 0.55
data existence: 0.65
data adequacy: 0.55
analysis feasibility: 0.65
operationalizability: 0.9

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: The cell types, repulsion, and deactivation rule are described in the paper, with further detail deferred to the supplement, so a reimplementation is analysis if those details are complete. The executable source is unpublished. Without it, a quantitative match to the four heads can be missed for reasons of parameter reconstruction, which limits how far the result can be resolved now.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Reimplement the two-cell reaction-diffusion and elastic-boundary model from the paper and supplement, deactivate subsets of the static signalling cells, and compare outline shape to the four observed heads with the same landmarks. Failure to recover those four outlines under the published rules would refute the quantitative claim.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
The original C++ program and its parameter file are not in a public repository.

Deactivating chosen subsets can be tuned until four shapes appear, so a match needs the published parameter set.
